</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Transition
from Deloitte to BDO</b></span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
August&#160;1, 2024, we notified Deloitte&#160;&amp; Touche LLP (&#8220;Deloitte&#8221;) of its dismissal, effective as of the same&#160;day,
as our independent registered public accounting firm. Deloitte served as our independent registered public accounting firm since the
closing of the Business Combination. The decision to change the independent public accounting firm was approved by our Audit Committee.</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the&#160;years ended December&#160;31, 2022 and 2023 and the subsequent interim period through July&#160;31, 2024, there were no: (1)&#160;disagreements
with Deloitte within the meaning of Item&#160;304(a)(1)(iv)&#160;of Regulation&#160;S-K&#160;on any matter of accounting principles or
practices, financial statement disclosure, or auditing scope or procedures, which disagreements, if not resolved to Deloitte&#8217;s
satisfaction, would have caused them to make reference in connection with their opinion to the subject matter of the disagreement, or
(2)&#160;reportable events under Item&#160;304(a)(1)(v)&#160;of Regulation&#160;S-K&#160;and the related instructions thereto, except
with respect to the material weaknesses as described below and in Item 9A of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
previously disclosed in our Annual Report on Form&#160;10-K for fiscal 2023, we determined that material weaknesses in our internal control
over financial reporting existed because (a)&#160;we did not have sufficient full-time&#160;accounting personnel, (i)&#160;to enable
appropriate reviews over the financial close and reporting process, (ii)&#160;to allow for appropriate segregation of duties, and (iii)&#160;with
the requisite experience and technical accounting knowledge to identify, review and resolve complex accounting issues under generally
accepted accounting principles in the U.S., and (b)&#160;with respect to inventory controls related to the completeness, existence, and
cut-off&#160;of the inventories held at third parties, and controls related to the calculation of adjustments to inventory for items
considered excessive and obsolete. Additionally, we did not adequately design and/or implement controls related to conducting a formal
risk assessment process.</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
audit reports of Deloitte on our consolidated financial statements as of and for the&#160;years ended December&#160;31, 2022 and 2023
did not contain an adverse opinion or a disclaimer of opinion, and were not qualified or modified as to uncertainty, audit scope or accounting
principles, except that there was an explanatory paragraph describing conditions that raised substantial doubt about our ability to continue
as a going concern in Deloitte&#8217;s audit opinions dated April&#160;6, 2023 and April&#160;1, 2024.</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
provided Deloitte with a copy of the auditor change disclosures prior to filing them with the Securities and Exchange Commission in our
Current Report on Form&#160;8-K&#160;on August&#160;1, 2024 (the &#8220;Form&#160;8-K&#8221;) and requested that Deloitte furnish a letter
addressed to the Securities and Exchange Commission stating whether or not it agreed with the statements made in the Form&#160;8-K, as
specified by Item&#160;304(a)(3)&#160;of Regulation&#160;S-K.&#160;A copy of Deloitte&#8217;s letter dated August&#160;1, 2024 was filed
as Exhibit 16.1 to the Form&#160;8-K.</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
August&#160;1, 2024, following the dismissal of Deloitte, the Audit Committee, after a competitive process to review the appointment
of the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting firm, approved the engagement of BDO USA, P.C. (&#8220;BDO&#8221;) as
the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting firm.</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
our fiscal&#160;years ended December&#160;31, 2022 and 2023 and through July&#160;31, 2024, neither the Company, nor anyone on its behalf,
consulted BDO regarding either: (i)&#160;the application of accounting principles to a specified transaction, either completed or proposed;
or the type of audit opinion that might be rendered on the Company&#8217;s financial statements; or (ii)&#160;any matter that was the
subject of a &#8220;disagreement&#8221; (as that term is defined in Item&#160;304(a)(1)(iv) of Regulation&#160;S-K) or &#8220;reportable
event&#8221; (as that term is defined in Item&#160;304(a)(1)(v) of Regulation&#160;S-K).</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>

The following are filed with this Annual Report on Form 10-K:</span></p><div>

</div><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p><div>
